name: Stochastic Depth Rendering
definition: A depth rendering approach that treats Gaussian primitives as stochastic solids and uses an attenuation function to align volume rendering with rasterization-based rendering, enabling principled depth estimation.
summary: Stochastic Depth Rendering computes depth maps by defining depth as the median transmittance crossing, providing sharper boundaries and superior multi-view consistency compared to standard Gaussian Splatting.
